blocks.text: Buying a 55+ Age-Restricted Condo in Pitt Meadows, BC

parts.t: 55+ apartment condos in the City of Pitt Meadows sit right in the flat, walkable heart of Central Meadows along McMyn Road, Ford Road, and Harris Road. Seniors and downsizers can walk on completely level sidewalks to Save-On-Foods, Shoppers Drug Mart, medical and dental clinics, the Pitt Meadows Library, Spirit Square, the Pitt Meadows Senior Activity Centre (19065 119B Ave), and the West Coast Express Station.

Because 55+ condo buildings enforce an age restriction under the BC Strata Property Act, they offer quiet hallways, community social rooms, and generous 900-to-1,200+ sq ft floor plans that accommodate full-sized dining sets and house furniture.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows 55+ Condo Strata Review: Bylaws, Elevators & CRF

parts.t: Before removing conditions on any Pitt Meadows 55+ condo, we review two full years of strata council and AGM/SGM minutes, the Form B Information Certificate (checking monthly strata fees, Contingency Reserve Fund balance, parking and storage locker designations, and any special levies), the building envelope and elevator Depreciation Report, and the exact 55+ occupancy and pet bylaws.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Pitt Meadows 55+ Senior Condos for Sale

parts.t: Where are 55+ condos located in Pitt Meadows?
55+ age-restricted condo buildings in Pitt Meadows are located in
along McMyn Road, Ford Road, and Harris Road, within a 2-to-5-minute flat walk of Meadowvale Shopping Centre, Spirit Square, and the Pitt Meadows Senior Activity Centre.
Are 55+ condo age restrictions still legal in BC?
Yes. British Columbia's Strata Property Act (as amended by Bill 44) expressly permits strata corporations to keep and enforce 55+ age-restriction bylaws.
What amenities are within walking distance of Central Meadows 55+ condos?

Residents can walk on flat sidewalks to the Pitt Meadows Senior Activity Centre (19065 119B Ave), Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre, Spirit Square, Pitt Meadows Public Library, grocery stores, pharmacies, medical clinics, and Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station (12185 Harris Rd).
Can an adult child buy a 55+ condo in Pitt Meadows for an aging parent?

Yes. Under the BC Strata Property Act, the 55+ age bylaw applies to the occupants residing in the strata lot rather than the registered owner on title, so a younger family member can be on title or on the mortgage while a parent aged 55+ occupies the unit.
Do 55+ condos in Pitt Meadows allow pets?
Pet bylaws vary by building: many allow one cat or one small dog, while some older 55+ stratas have stricter pet limitations. Always check the registered strata bylaws before writing an offer.
What should I check in the Depreciation Report for a 55+ condo building?

Check the age and remaining service life of the roof membrane, exterior siding/rainscreen, windows, domestic water piping, and elevator mechanicals, and compare those timelines against the strata's Contingency Reserve Fund (CRF) balance.
